newsitem.title: USA: Omaha Public 478 MW Neb. nuke seen up this week.
newsitem.headline: Omaha Public 478 MW Neb. nuke seen up this week.

text.p: Omaha Public Power District's 478 megawatt Fort Calhoun nuclear power plant was likely to resume power production later this week from a maintenance outage, a company spokesman said Monday.
"We're looking at having it back on line Thursday or Friday," company spokesman Gary Williams said.
The Fort Calhoun, Neb. plant was taken off line Oct 5 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
The Fort Calhoun plant is Omaha Public's only nulcear power facility.
